glassblowing_batch_20260921_note: Completed all eight glassblowing stickers and reviewed every selected master on the transparent/dark viewer for subject, silhouette, padding and internal openings. Jacks were regenerated to remove ordinary scissor finger loops. Marver was simplified to four clean legs. Furnace accessories and the inaccurate wooden-handled pipe were removed. The vase's copied floral decoration was removed. Block and diamond shears were reframed after edge contact; shears jaws were corrected to opposing V-notches forming a visible diamond opening. Alpha-only margin cleanup was selected for jacks and marver with RGB and dimensions preserved. A shears alpha-only trial that erased artwork was rejected and never promoted. Paperweight was accepted from its first pass. All selected files are 1254 x 1254 RGBA with transparent corners; fine white fringe in complex openings remains subject to game-scale review.
leathercraft_batch_20260921_note: Completed all eight leathercraft stickers and visually reviewed every selected master for subject, silhouette, tool anatomy, padding, white cut margin and transparent background. The first edge-beveler pass was rejected because its long fork resembled a nail puller; the selected version has a short precision shank and tiny notched cutting tip. The first pricking-iron pass was rejected for showing five teeth; the selected version has exactly four. The mallet's spurious top knob was removed. All eight selected compositions were reframed for clearer padding. Authorized alpha-only cleanup removed detached white fringe from the edge beveler, mallet, card sleeve, belt and hide roll while preserving canvas dimensions and RGB artwork. Selected files are 1254 x 1254 RGBA with clear transparent corners; acceptance is provisional and game-scale inspection may still reveal fine fringe or small-detail issues.
